_meta.description: Flow velocity calculation parameters and thresholds per BS-SPEC-OCA-002-REV0 §5.2

units.inner_diameter: mm (input), converted to m for calculation

velocity_calculation.notes: Incompressible flow assumption. For compressible flow at high Mach numbers, this underestimates velocity.

thresholds.description: Particle impact velocity threshold. Above this velocity, particles carry sufficient kinetic energy for ignition of flammable targets.
thresholds.note: The 100 ft/s (30 m/s) threshold is widely cited. Some references use lower thresholds for specific materials.

thresholds.description: Critical pressure ratio for sonic flow (choked flow) in O2. P_upstream / P_downstream > 1.893 produces Mach 1 at the throat.
thresholds.source: Isentropic flow relations, gamma = 1.4 for O2
